items.q: Who decides whether water already used is affected?
items.a: Your quality unit, or whoever owns your water specification. Our signed service report gives it the facts: when readings left specification, where, what we found and what we did. We do not release water.

items.q: We have no service plan. Will you come?
items.a: Yes, in an area agreed per project, as a call-out with the next available technician. You pay call-out, hourly and travel rates quoted at booking, and parts as quoted. Every visit ends with a signed report.
